content.comment_body: Hello! My client is looking for a printed version of the [product_name] manual. Is it still possible to obtain one these days? I wasn't able to find anything on the [company_name] website. /[user_name]

You can download manuals for all [product_name] devices (except for the latest [article_no] model): Technical documentation [product_name] Controller. The manual for the new [article_no] variant is available for download here: [product_name] device manual edition 07/2016.
Thanks, but my client is specifically interested in printed manuals that aren't simply downloadable. They do not wish to print out the PDFs themselves.
As far as I'm aware, the manuals are only offered in PDF format and I haven't seen any available as physical books.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are searching for official printed manuals for the [product_name], especially recent versions, but only digital PDF options seem to be available. This indicates a strong preference for physical documentation and highlights a gap in the current documentation options provided.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that official printed manuals for the [product_name] should be easily accessible for those who do not wish to rely on digital files.
